text: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发布关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见。其中提出，完善企业常态化参与国家科技和产业发展战略、规划、政策制定机制。推动国家自然科学基金试点向民营企业开放，扩大企业创新发展联合基金范围和规模。鼓励国有企业加快建立独立核算、免于增值保值考核、容错纠错的研发准备金制度。
text_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued opinions on promoting the deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation. Among them, it is proposed to improve the mechanism for enterprises to participate in the formulation of national science and technology and industrial development strategies, plans, and policies on a regular basis. Promote pilot opening of the National Natural Science Foundation of China to private enterprises and expand the scope and scale of enterprise innovation and development joint funds. Encourage state-owned enterprises to accelerate the establishment of R&D reserve fund systems with independent accounting, exemption from value-preservation and appreciation assessment, and fault tolerance and error correction.
